blocks.orig: Situated on a secluded rocky outcrop amidst lush gardens overlooking Lake Tanganyika, the Kigoma Hilltop Hotel offers a lovely retreat close to the city of Kigoma in the west of Tanzania. All 30 hotel bungalows are equipped with large four-poster beds, ensuite bathrooms and private terraces overlooking the lake. Both the swimming pool and the restaurant offer the same magnificent view, with the Sangara Restaurant (sangara meaning perch, a fish frequently caught in the lake) boasting a terrace above the water, allowing you to enjoy the view while having breakfast, lunch or dinner.
blocks.html: On a secluded rocky outcrop with lush gardens looking out over Lake Tanganyika, the Kigoma Hilltop Hotel is a lovely retreat near the city of Kigoma in the west of Tanzania. Each of the 30 bungalows has a large four-poster bed, an ensuite bathroom and a private terrace with a view of the lake. The swimming pool and the restaurant share that same magnificent view, and the Sangara Restaurant (sangara means perch, a fish often caught in the lake) has a terrace above the water, so you can take in the scenery over breakfast, lunch or dinner.
